Definition: a stumbling-block, but only figuratively (fall, enticement (idol))
BiblicalUsage: 1) overthrown mass, stumbling-block, something overthrown, decay, ruin; 1a) thing overthrown (figurative of kingdom); 1b) stumbling-block (of idols)
